summary: A2Z Cust2Mate Solutions Corp. (Nasdaq: AZ) furnished a 6-K on October 6, 2026, announcing completion of its acquisition of Heidia Ltd., an Israeli in-store retail media company, alongside an investor presentation. Heidia reported FY25 audited revenue of approximately $20 million and is described as profitable and cash-generating, founded in 1988, with advertiser relationships including Unilever, Kimberly-Clark, Procter & Gamble, Nike and Henkel. No purchase price, share consideration, premium or break fee was disclosed. The deal combines Cust2Mate's smart-cart media inventory and shopper-journey data with Hedia's advertiser sales and campaign execution, targeting integrated retail media expansion beyond Israel.
